+#include "libavutil/attributes.h"
+#include "libavutil/cpu.h"
+#include "libavutil/riscv/cpu.h"
+#include "libavcodec/avcodec.h"
+#include "libavcodec/fdctdsp.h"
+
+void ff_jpeg_fdct_islow_8_rvv(int16_t *data);
+
+av_cold void ff_fdctdsp_init_riscv(FDCTDSPContext *c, AVCodecContext *avctx,
+                                   unsigned high_bit_depth)
+{
+#if HAVE_RVV
+    int flags = av_get_cpu_flags();
+
+    if (!high_bit_depth && (flags & AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV_I32) &&
+        ff_rv_vlen_least(128)) {
+        /* ff_jpeg_fdct_islow_8 is the default (dct_algo == FF_DCT_AUTO or
+         * explicitly selected slow/accurate).  Only override that exact
+         * algorithm; ff_fdct_ifast / ff_faandct keep their own paths. */
+        if (avctx->dct_algo != FF_DCT_FASTINT
+#if CONFIG_FAANDCT
+            && avctx->dct_algo != FF_DCT_FAAN
+#endif
+            && avctx->bits_per_raw_sample < 9) {
+            c->fdct = ff_jpeg_fdct_islow_8_rvv;
+        }
+    }
+#endif
+}
diff --git a/libavcodec/riscv/fdctdsp_rvv.S b/libavcodec/riscv/fdctdsp_rvv.S
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..0a4c8abb39
--- /dev/null
+++ b/libavcodec/riscv/fdctdsp_rvv.S
@@ -0,0 +1,263 @@
+/*

+ * Lesser General Public License for more details.
+ *
+ * You should have received a copy of the GNU Lesser General Public
+ * License along with FFmpeg; if not, write to the Free Software
+ * Foundation, Inc., 51 Franklin Street, Fifth Floor, Boston, MA 02110-1301 USA
+ */
+
+#include "libavutil/riscv/asm.S"
+
+/* ff_jpeg_fdct_islow_8 RVV implementation.
+ * The 8-point butterfly of jfdctint_template.c is applied lane-wise:
+ * - Pass 1 (rows): the 8x8 block is loaded as 8 COLUMN vectors (vlse16,
+ *   stride = 16 bytes), so the row butterfly on row r becomes a vector op
+ *   across the 8 column vectors at lane r (pairs x0+x7, x1+x6, ...).
+ *   Results are stored back in-place column-wise (vsse16, stride 16),
+ *   which reproduces the C row-major intermediate exactly.
+ * - Pass 2 (columns): reload the intermediate as 8 ROW vectors (vle16)
+ *   and apply the same butterfly lane-wise. Store back row-wise.
+ *
+ * All multiplies are done in e32 (mod 2^32), DESCALE(x,n) = (x+(1<<(n-1)))>>n
+ * via vadd.vx + vsra.vi, truncation to int16 via vnsrl.wi (low 16 bits),
+ * matching the C integer semantics bit-exactly.
+ *
+ * regs: v0..v7 = 8 input vectors (e16, 8 lanes), v8..v31 = temps (e32).
+ */
+
+/* FDCT butterfly macro, applied to 8 vectors v0..v7 (e32).
+ * descale output ordering: out0..out7 = e0,o1,e2,o3,e4,o5,e6,o7.
+ * \even_shift: even outputs e0/e4 (pass1: 4=<<PASS1_BITS; pass2: 4=OUT_SHIFT)
+ * \odd_shift:  odd outputs o1..o7 and e2/e6 descale
+ * \even_round: rounding bias for even outputs (pass1: 0; pass2: 1<<(4-1)=8)
+ * \odd_round:  rounding bias for odd outputs (pass1: 1<<8=256; pass2: 1<<16)
+ */
+.macro fdct_butterfly even_shift, odd_shift, even_round, odd_round
+        /* t0a..t7a */
+        vadd.vv v8,  v0, v7        /* t0a = in0+in7 */
+        vsub.vv v9,  v0, v7        /* t7a = in0-in7 */
+        vadd.vv v10, v1, v6        /* t1a = in1+in6 */
+        vsub.vv v11, v1, v6        /* t6a = in1-in6 */
+        vadd.vv v12, v2, v5        /* t2a = in2+in5 */
+        vsub.vv v13, v2, v5        /* t5a = in2-in5 */
+        vadd.vv v14, v3, v4        /* t3a = in3+in4 */
+        vsub.vv v15, v3, v4        /* t4a = in3-in4 */
+        /* tmp10..tmp13 */
+        vadd.vv v16, v8,  v14      /* tmp10 = t0a+t3a */
+        vsub.vv v17, v8,  v14      /* tmp13 = t0a-t3a */
+        vadd.vv v18, v10, v12      /* tmp11 = t1a+t2a */
+        vsub.vv v19, v10, v12      /* tmp12 = t1a-t2a */
+        /* even: e0 = tmp10+tmp11 ; e4 = tmp10-tmp11 */
+        vadd.vv v20, v16, v18
+        vsub.vv v21, v16, v18
+        /* z1 = (tmp12+tmp13)*4433 ; e2/e6 */
+        vadd.vv v22, v19, v17      /* tmp12+tmp13 */
+        li      t5, 4433
+        vmul.vx v22, v22, t5       /* z1 */
+        li      t5, 6270
+        vmul.vx v23, v17, t5       /* tmp13*6270 */
+        vadd.vv v23, v23, v22      /* e2 = z1 + tmp13*6270 */
+        li      t5, -15137
+        vmul.vx v24, v19, t5       /* tmp12*(-15137) */
+        vadd.vv v24, v24, v22      /* e6 = z1 + tmp12*(-15137) */
+        /* odd part */
+        vadd.vv v25, v15, v9       /* z1 = t4a+t7a */
+        vadd.vv v26, v13, v11      /* z2 = t5a+t6a */
+        vadd.vv v27, v15, v11      /* z3 = t4a+t6a */
+        vadd.vv v28, v13, v9       /* z4 = t5a+t7a */
+        vadd.vv v29, v27, v28      /* z3+z4 */
+        li      t5, 9633
+        vmul.vx v29, v29, t5       /* z5 = (z3+z4)*9633 */
+        li      t5, 2446
+        vmul.vx v15, v15, t5       /* t4a*2446 */
+        li      t5, 16819
+        vmul.vx v13, v13, t5       /* t5a*16819 */
+        li      t5, 25172
+        vmul.vx v11, v11, t5       /* t6a*25172 */
+        li      t5, 12299
+        vmul.vx v9,  v9,  t5       /* t7a*12299 */
+        li      t5, -7373
+        vmul.vx v25, v25, t5       /* z1*(-7373) */
+        li      t5, -20995
+        vmul.vx v26, v26, t5       /* z2*(-20995) */
+        li      t5, -16069
+        vmul.vx v27, v27, t5       /* z3*(-16069) */
+        li      t5, -3196
+        vmul.vx v28, v28, t5       /* z4*(-3196) */
+        vadd.vv v27, v27, v29      /* z3 += z5 */
+        vadd.vv v28, v28, v29      /* z4 += z5 */
+        vadd.vv v30, v15, v25      /* o7 = t4a+z1+z3 */
+        vadd.vv v30, v30, v27
+        vadd.vv v31, v13, v26      /* o5 = t5a+z2+z4 */
+        vadd.vv v31, v31, v28
+        vadd.vv v13, v11, v26      /* o3 = t6a+z2+z3 */
+        vadd.vv v13, v13, v27
+        vadd.vv v11, v9,  v25      /* o1 = t7a+z1+z4 */
+        vadd.vv v11, v11, v28
+        /* descale + narrow to e16 */
+.if \even_round
+        li      t5, \even_round
+        vadd.vx v20, v20, t5
+        vadd.vx v21, v21, t5
+.endif
+.if \even_shift < 0
+        /* pass 1: even outputs are << PASS1_BITS (no rounding) */
+        vsll.vi v20, v20, -\even_shift
+        vsll.vi v21, v21, -\even_shift
+.else
+        vsra.vi v20, v20, \even_shift
+        vsra.vi v21, v21, \even_shift
+.endif
+        li      t5, \odd_round
+        vadd.vx v23, v23, t5
+        vadd.vx v24, v24, t5
+        vadd.vx v11, v11, t5
+        vadd.vx v13, v13, t5
+        vadd.vx v30, v30, t5
+        vadd.vx v31, v31, t5
+        vsra.vi v23, v23, \odd_shift
+        vsra.vi v24, v24, \odd_shift
+        vsra.vi v11, v11, \odd_shift
+        vsra.vi v13, v13, \odd_shift
+        vsra.vi v30, v30, \odd_shift
+        vsra.vi v31, v31, \odd_shift
+        vnsrl.wi v0,  v20, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v1,  v11, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v2,  v23, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v3,  v13, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v4,  v21, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v5,  v31, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v6,  v24, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v7,  v30, 0
+.endm
+
+/* Load 8 columns (stride 16 bytes) as e16 vectors and widen to e32.
+ * vwcvt must be issued in e16 mode (sim widens from self.vsew). */
+.macro fdct_load_cols base, stride
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vlse16.v v0,  (\base), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v0,  v0
+        add     t0, \base, 2
+        vlse16.v v1,  (t0), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v1,  v1
+        add     t0, \base, 4
+        vlse16.v v2,  (t0), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v2,  v2
+        add     t0, \base, 6
+        vlse16.v v3,  (t0), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v3,  v3
+        add     t0, \base, 8
+        vlse16.v v4,  (t0), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v4,  v4
+        add     t0, \base, 10
+        vlse16.v v5,  (t0), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v5,  v5
+        add     t0, \base, 12
+        vlse16.v v6,  (t0), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v6,  v6
+        add     t0, \base, 14
+        vlse16.v v7,  (t0), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v7,  v7
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e32, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+/* Store 8 e16 vectors column-wise (stride 16 bytes) — writes the C
+ * row-major intermediate in place. */
+.macro fdct_store_cols base, stride
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vsse16.v v0,  (\base), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 2
+        vsse16.v v1,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 4
+        vsse16.v v2,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 6
+        vsse16.v v3,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 8
+        vsse16.v v4,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 10
+        vsse16.v v5,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 12
+        vsse16.v v6,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 14
+        vsse16.v v7,  (t0), \stride
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e32, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+/* Load 8 rows (consecutive int16) as e16 vectors and widen to e32. */
+.macro fdct_load_rows base
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vle16.v  v0,  (\base)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v0,  v0
+        add     t0, \base, 16
+        vle16.v  v1,  (t0)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v1,  v1
+        add     t0, \base, 32
+        vle16.v  v2,  (t0)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v2,  v2
+        add     t0, \base, 48
+        vle16.v  v3,  (t0)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v3,  v3
+        add     t0, \base, 64
+        vle16.v  v4,  (t0)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v4,  v4
+        add     t0, \base, 80
+        vle16.v  v5,  (t0)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v5,  v5
+        add     t0, \base, 96
+        vle16.v  v6,  (t0)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v6,  v6
+        add     t0, \base, 112
+        vle16.v  v7,  (t0)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v7,  v7
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e32, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+/* Store 8 e16 row vectors back row-wise. */
+.macro fdct_store_rows base
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vse16.v  v0,  (\base)
+        add     t0, \base, 16
+        vse16.v  v1,  (t0)
+        add     t0, \base, 32
+        vse16.v  v2,  (t0)
+        add     t0, \base, 48
+        vse16.v  v3,  (t0)
+        add     t0, \base, 64
+        vse16.v  v4,  (t0)
+        add     t0, \base, 80
+        vse16.v  v5,  (t0)
+        add     t0, \base, 96
+        vse16.v  v6,  (t0)
+        add     t0, \base, 112
+        vse16.v  v7,  (t0)
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e32, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+/* Pass 1 (row transform): intermediate scaled by 2^PASS1_BITS on the even
+ * outputs (no rounding), odd outputs DESCALE by CONST_BITS-PASS1_BITS = 9
+ * with rounding bias 1<<8.  Stored to the block in place (row-major). */
+func ff_jpeg_fdct_islow_8_rvv, zve32x
+        lpad    0
+        li      t4, 16
+        fdct_load_cols a0, t4
+        fdct_butterfly -4, 9, 0, 256
+        fdct_store_cols a0, t4
+        /* Pass 2 (column transform): even DESCALE by OUT_SHIFT = PASS1_BITS
+         * = 4 (bias 8), odd DESCALE by CONST_BITS+OUT_SHIFT = 17 (bias 1<<16) */
+        fdct_load_rows a0
+        fdct_butterfly 4, 17, 8, 65536
+        fdct_store_rows a0
+        ret
+endfunc
